subtasks.description: Add versioned model/prompt/capability manifests with language, task, license, endpoint, region and structured-output support.
Define per-tenant stage policies and immutable policy snapshots on each run.
Implement privacy/eligibility filtering before health, quality, latency and cost selection.
Qualify chosen local and API adapters through identical typed contract tests, including schema rejection and usage reporting.
Add deadlines, rate limits, backoff, Retry-After, health circuits and approved same-policy fallback.
Block unauthorized egress at network and application layers; test local failure with cloud keys configured.
